title: observability: token/kv enhanced logging + metrics dashboard + alert tuning
author: Amir Haddad
release_notes: Adds token-level KV cache metrics and structured logging for cache decisions; ships new Grafana dashboards and updates alert thresholds to reduce noise. Backwards compatible.
description: Motivation: Improve production observability for token-level and KV cache behavior to reduce incident MTTR and noisy alerts. This PR adds new metrics, structured logs for cache routing/decisions, a Grafana dashboard with cost/latency breakdown by token stage, and alert tuning to reduce false positives while keeping SLO guardrails. Summary of changes: 1) metrics: token.kv.cache_hit, token.kv.cache_miss, token.kv.cache_eviction_age, token.latency.decode, token.latency.kv_access, token.cost.per_token; added labels for model, region, deployment_tier; 2) logging: structured JSON logs for cache routing (decision, key_shard, upstream_fallback, reason), added sampling for debug-level logs and redaction of PII traces; 3) dashboards: Grafana dashboard files under observability/dashboards/token-kv-... with panels for hit-rate by model, cost-per-token breakdown, tail latency per stage (kv access vs decode), KV cache age distributions; 4) alerts: tuned existing alerts - increased burn-rate window for cache-miss spike alerts, added adaptive thresholds for models with bursty traffic, introduced a SIGSEV guard for anomalous fill-rate regressions; 5) rollout: feature gates and rollout plan included to enable metrics/logging for 5% of traffic -> 25% -> 100%. Checklist: - [x] Metrics schema defined and instrumented in runtime - [x] Structured logs implemented and tested locally - [x] Grafana dashboard JSONs added and linted - [x] Alert rules updated and tested against historical incidents - [x] Load-tested at 1x and 5x expected traffic - [x] Docs updated (observability/README) Backwards compatibility notes: metric names are additive, labels are optional. Logs are behind feature flag config.observability.enhanced_token_kv and default to off for private deployments. Testing: unit tests for metric tagging and log redaction; integration test in perf-canary that validates dashboards ingest; manual canary on staging cluster for 72h (no regressions). Related: ENG-4521 for rollout plan, SUP-7812 customer incident that motivated KV-age metric. Links: dashboard JSONs in this PR for review. Merge strategy: squash merge after approvals.
